retrievalProfile.description: A close-up portrait of a subject in a bucket hat against a vibrant warm-toned gradient, featuring wide-tracked serif typography at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly tilted headshot of a person wearing a textured bucket hat and overalls, set against a smooth yellow-to-orange radial gradient. The composition is anchored by a prominent, wide-tracked serif title across the top margin.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hat color harmonizes with the background gradient
Typography spans the width of the frame above the subject's head
Tilted head angle creates a dynamic diagonal within the square frame
High-contrast black hair and overalls ground the warm color palette
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a textured bucket hat
Wide-tracked serif typography at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up portrait, head tilted diagonally, filling the center and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the brim of the bucket hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold typography at the top, moves down to the eyes, and follows the tilt of the head toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily located in the upper corners around the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and yellows in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair, overalls, and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft skin tones and subtle highlights on the hat texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with deep, rich values in the subject's features.

letterConstructionRules: Varying cap heights for visual rhythm
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial and specific internal letters to create a staggered baseline effect

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the negative space above the head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying scales and tracking for emphasis.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the small-cap feel and sharp serifs
Similar flared serifs and classical weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up studio portrait of a person with braids wearing a fuzzy orange bucket hat and orange turtleneck, tilted head, against a vibrant yellow-to-orange radial gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of wide-tracked, black serif text in all caps across the top margin, ensuring the letters are spaced evenly across the width.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth warm gradient?
Is the typography wide-tracked and serif?
Is the subject wearing a bucket hat?
Is the text placed at the very top of the frame?

mustAchieve: Smooth color transitions in the gradient
Sharp focus on the subject's eyes

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's hat
Ensure the gradient is free of banding
Verify the 90s R&B photographic lighting style
Confirm the serif font has sharp, distinct terminals
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Bucket Hat + Warm Gradient + Wide-Tracked Serif Header
